---
title: "Permutation Test: Path2D DPS (Lite)"
subtitle: "1000 label permutations for thresholds 7 & 8"
---

## Overview

Label permutation test to validate dementia progression patterns. Shuffles demcat labels 1000 times and computes Path2D DPS for all 15 dimension pairs, building a null distribution for empirical p-value computation.

## Configuration

```{r}
#| label: config

N_PERMUTATIONS <- 1000
THRESHOLDS <- c(7, 8)
SEED_BASE <- 42
```

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(furrr, fs, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-custom-functions

source(here("custom_func/find_highest_density_points.R"))
source(here("custom_func/compute_spatial_dps.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-parallel

plan(multicore, workers = 10)
message(glue("Parallel backend: {nbrOfWorkers()} workers"))
```

## Constants

```{r}
#| label: constants

progression_order <- c(
  "normal2mci", "stable_normal", "stable_mci",
  "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev_dementia"
)
```

## Dimension Pair Backbone

```{r}
#| label: dim-pairs

dim_pairs <- expand_grid(
  dimx = glue("umap_{1:6}"),
  dimy = glue("umap_{1:6}")
) |>
  filter(dimx < dimy)

message(glue("Dimension pairs: {nrow(dim_pairs)}"))
```

## Generate Permutation Seeds

```{r}
#| label: perm-seeds

set.seed(SEED_BASE)
perm_seeds <- sample.int(1e6, N_PERMUTATIONS)
message(glue("Generated {N_PERMUTATIONS} permutation seeds"))
```

## Run Permutations

Process both thresholds sequentially, each with parallel permutations.

```{r}
#| label: run-permutations

output_dir <- here("UMAP/lite/output")
fs::dir_create(output_dir)

for (threshold in THRESHOLDS) {
  message(glue("\n=== Processing threshold {threshold} ==="))

  # Load embedding
  embedding <- read_rds(here(output_dir, glue("embedding_threshold_{threshold}.rds")))
  message(glue("Embedding: {nrow(embedding)} subjects"))

  tictoc::tic(glue("Threshold {threshold} permutations"))

  perm_results <- future_map(seq_len(N_PERMUTATIONS), function(perm_id) {
    # Shuffle demcat labels
    set.seed(perm_seeds[perm_id])
    perm_embedding <- embedding |>
      mutate(demcat = sample(demcat))

    # Process all 15 dimension pairs
    pair_results <- pmap(dim_pairs, function(dimx, dimy) {
      # Find density peaks
      peaks <- try(
        find_highest_density_points(
          perm_embedding,
          dim_cols = c(dimx, dimy),
          category_col = "demcat",
          density_threshold = 0.9,
          grid_resolution = 200,
          bandwidth = "nrd0",
          min_points = 20
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )

      if (inherits(peaks, "try-error")) return(NULL)

      # Compute centroids
      centroids <- peaks |>
        summarise(
          x_mean = mean(x_highest_densities),
          y_mean = mean(y_highest_densities),
          .by = demcat
        )

      # Check all categories present
      ordered_centroids <- centroids |>
        filter(demcat %in% progression_order) |>
        mutate(
          demcat = factor(demcat, levels = progression_order),
          order_int = as.integer(demcat)
        ) |>
        arrange(order_int)

      if (nrow(ordered_centroids) != length(progression_order)) return(NULL)

      # Compute Path2D DPS only
      path2d <- compute_path2d_dps(ordered_centroids$x_mean, ordered_centroids$y_mean)

      tibble(perm_id = perm_id, dimx = dimx, dimy = dimy, path2d_dps = path2d)
    })

    discard(pair_results, is.null) |> list_rbind()
  }, .progress = TRUE, .options = furrr_options(seed = NULL))

  tictoc::toc()

  # Combine and save
  perm_dps <- list_rbind(perm_results)
  message(glue("Permutation DPS rows: {nrow(perm_dps)} (expected: {N_PERMUTATIONS * nrow(dim_pairs)})"))

  write_rds(perm_dps, here(output_dir, glue("permutation_dps_threshold_{threshold}.rds")))
  message(glue("Saved: permutation_dps_threshold_{threshold}.rds"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cleanup-parallel

plan(sequential)
```

## Verify Outputs

```{r}
#| label: verify

walk(THRESHOLDS, \(t) {
  perm <- read_rds(here(output_dir, glue("permutation_dps_threshold_{t}.rds")))
  message(glue("Threshold {t}: {nrow(perm)} rows, {n_distinct(perm$perm_id)} permutations"))
})
```
